newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: BEST OFFER FOR NEPAL DIESEL TENDER AT UNDER $177/T.
newsitem.headline: BEST OFFER FOR NEPAL DIESEL TENDER AT UNDER $177/T.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) tender to buy 0.5-percent gas oil for September saw the best offer from German trader Mabanaft at around $176.99 per tonne, industry sources said.
The next best offer was from Japanese trading house Tomen Corp at $177.15 per tonne, they said.
The tender closed on Wednesday and is expected to be awarded late Thursday.
Eight offers were submitted into the tender, at levels ranging between just under $177 to $188, traders said.
The tender seeks 30,000 tonnes of 0.5-percent gas oil on a cost-and-freight basis to the Indian east coast for delivery September 21-30.
In its last tender, NOC bought two gas oil cargoes, from Shell at $162.69 per tonne, and BB Energy at $163.44.
